headline: EPS nearly doubles year-over-year
summary_short: santec Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥230.40, up 96.0% y/y from ¥117.58.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥230.40 nearly doubled year-over-year, up 96.0% from ¥117.58, and rose a further 32.6% sequentially from ¥173.77 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
